summary: The separate predictor failed all 20 required accuracy comparisons. Replaying its recorded tests reproduced the results exactly. The live brain was unchanged.
decision: Give the test predictor achieved body positions in the same coordinates as its commands, teach differences between commands, and share contact learning across skin sites. Confirm changes in new worlds.
measurement: Across reserved worlds: body-position differences between commands were 0.279 cm RMS; forecast error was 0.484 cm. Pressure differences were 0.327 kPa; forecast error was 4.737 kPa. These describe this bounded copied study.
